    const confirmBtn = modal.querySelector('#quantity-confirm');
    const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('#quantity-cancel');
    const addAllBtn = modal.querySelector('#quantity-add-all');

    const syncValues = (source) => {
        const value = source.value;
        if (source === slider) input.value = value;

renderGalleryTab() {
    const container = document.getElementById('gacha-tab-gallery');
    let gridHtml = '';
    const allChars = [...this.gachaCharacterPool.ssr, ...this.gachaCharacterPool.sr, ...this.gachaCharacterPool.r];
    // 按稀有度排序
    allChars.sort((a,b) => (b.rarity === 'SSR' ? 3 : b.rarity === 'SR' ? 2 : 1) - (a.rarity === 'SSR' ? 3 : a.rarity === 'SR' ? 2 : 1));

    allChars.forEach(char => {
        const isUnlocked = this.gachaCollection[char.id];
        const cardClass = `gallery-card rarity-${char.rarity} ${isUnlocked ? 'unlocked' : 'gallery-card-locked'}`;
        const bgImageStyle = isUnlocked && char.image ? `background-image: url('${char.image}');` : '';
gridHtml += `
        <div class="${cardClass}" title="${char.name} - ${char.series}" data-char-id="${char.id}" style="${bgImageStyle}">
                ${isUnlocked ? `<div class="gallery-card-name">${char.name}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
        `;
    });
    container.innerHTML = `<div class="gallery-grid">${gridHtml}</div>`;

    // 绑定点击事件
    container.querySelector('.gallery-grid').addEventListener('click', e => {
        const card = e.target.closest('.gallery-card.unlocked');
        if (!card) return;
        const charId = card.dataset.charId;
        const charData = allChars.find(c => c.id === charId);
        if (charData) {
            this.showGachaCharacterDetails(charData);
        }
    });
},

          openModal(modalId, keepOpen = false) {
    if (!keepOpen) {
        this.closeAllModals();
    }
    const modal = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        if (keepOpen) {
            const highestZ = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay'))
                .filter(el => el.style.display === 'flex' && el.id !== modalId)
                .reduce((maxZ, el) => Math.max(maxZ, parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(el).zIndex, 10) || 1000), 1000);
            modal.style.zIndex = highestZ + 1;
        } else {
            modal.style.zIndex = '';
        }
    }
},

          closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(modal => {
        modal.style.display = 'none';
    });
    // 关键修复：当关闭任何模态框时，都检查并清除导入状态
    if (this.importedSaveData) {
        this.importedSaveData = null;
        this.showTemporaryMessage('存档导入已取消。');

          showCustomConfirm(message, onConfirm, onCancel = null) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('custom-confirm-modal');
    const messageEl = document.getElementById('custom-confirm-message');
    const okBtn = document.getElementById('custom-confirm-btn-ok');
    const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('custom-confirm-btn-cancel');

    if (!modal || !messageEl || !okBtn || !cancelBtn) return;

    messageEl.innerHTML = message; 

    // 使用 .cloneNode(true) 来移除旧的事件监听器，防止重复触发
    const newOkBtn = okBtn.cloneNode(true);
    okBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(newOkBtn, okBtn);

    const newCancelBtn = cancelBtn.cloneNode(true);
    cancelBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(newCancelBtn, cancelBtn);

    newOkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.closeAllModals();
        if (typeof onConfirm === 'function') {
            onConfirm();
        }
    });

    // 【核心修正】为“取消”按钮添加回调逻辑
    newCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.closeAllModals();
        if (typeof onCancel === 'function') {

        }
    });

    this.openModal('custom-confirm-modal');
},

    if (!this.currentMvuState || !this.currentMvuState.stat_data) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('无法操作，状态数据丢失。');
        return;
    }
     const newState = _.cloneDeep(this.currentMvuState);

    if (!character) {

    }

            this.showTemporaryMessage(`已将 “${charName}” ${character.isImportant ? '标记为重要人物' : '取消重要标记'}`);

         getTierStyle(tier) {
            const demigodGlow = 'text-shadow: 0 0 5px currentColor, 0 0 8px currentColor;';
            const angelGlow = 'animation: ethereal-pulse 3s infinite; text-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor, 0 0 12px currentColor;';
            const godGlow = `background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E6E6FA, #D8BFD8, #DDA0DD); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; ${angelGlow}`;

            const styles = {
              '序列9': 'color: #A9A9A9;',
              '序列8': 'color: #BDB76B;',
              '序列7': 'color: #8B4513;',
              '序列6': 'color: #556B2F;',
              '序列5': 'color: #483D8B;',
              '序列4': `color: #B22222; ${demigodGlow}`,
              '序列3': `color: #DAA520; ${demigodGlow}`,
              '序列2': `color: #C0C0C0; ${angelGlow}`,
              '序列1': `color: #FFD700; ${angelGlow}`,
              '序列0': godGlow,
            };
            const baseStyle = 'font-family: "Georgia", serif;';
            return (styles[tier] || 'color: #D3D3D3;') + baseStyle;
          },

          getTierOrder(tier) {
            const tierOrder = {
              '普通': 1, '非凡': 2, '罕见': 3, '史诗': 4,
              '传说': 5, '神话': 6, '唯一': 7,

              '序列9': 1, '序列8': 2, '序列7': 3, '序列6': 4,
              '序列5': 5, '序列4': 6, '序列3': 7, '序列2': 8, '序列1': 9, '序列0': 10
            };
            return tierOrder[tier] || 0;
          },

          sortByTier(items, getTierFn) {
            if (!Array.isArray(items)) return items;
            return [...items].sort((a, b) => {
              const tierA = getTierFn(a);
              const tierB = getTierFn(b);
              const orderA = this.getTierOrder(tierA);
              const orderB = this.getTierOrder(tierB);
              if (orderA === orderB) return 0;
              return orderB - orderA;
            });
          },

          getTierColorStyle(tier) {
            const demigodGlow = 'text-shadow: 0 0 5px currentColor, 0 0 8px currentColor;';
            const legendGlow = 'animation: ethereal-pulse 3s infinite; text-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor, 0 0 12px currentColor;';
            const mythGlow = `background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E6E6FA, #D8BFD8, #DDA0DD); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; ${legendGlow}`;

            const tierColors = {
              普通: '#A9A9A9',
              非凡: '#BDB76B',
              罕见: '#8B4513',
              史诗: `color: #B22222; ${demigodGlow}`,
              传说: `color: #C0C0C0; ${legendGlow}`,
              神话: `color: #FFD700; ${legendGlow}`,
              唯一: mythGlow,
            };
            const color = tierColors[tier] || '#D3D3D3';
            if (typeof color === 'string' && color.startsWith('color')) return color;
            if (typeof color === 'string' && color.startsWith('background')) return color;
            return `color: ${color};`;
          },

formatObject(obj, depth = 0) {
  if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return String(obj); // 非对象/数组直接转字符串
  }
  if (depth > 2) return '[深层结构]'; // 限制嵌套深度
  return Object.entries(obj)
    .map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${this.formatObject(v, depth + 1)}`) // 递归调用时用 this
    .join('，');
},

                    const rawDescription = this.SafeGetValue(item, ['描述', 'description'], '无描述');
                    const description = this.formatObject(rawDescription);

                    const pendingUses = this.pendingActions.filter(action => action.action === 'use' && action.itemName === name).reduce((total, action) => total + action.quantity, 0);
                    const pendingDiscards = this.pendingActions.filter(action => action.action === 'discard' && action.itemName === name).reduce((total, action) => total + action.quantity, 0);
                    const displayQuantity = quantity - pendingUses - pendingDiscards;

                    if ((hasQuantity && displayQuantity <= 0) || (!hasQuantity && pendingDiscards > 0)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    const formattedTier = tier !== '无' && !isNaN(tier) ? `序列${tier}` : tier;
                    const tierStyle = this.getTierStyle(formattedTier);
                    const tierDisplay = tier !== '无' ? `<span class="item-tier-display" style="${tierStyle}">等阶: ${formattedTier}</span>` : '';
                    const quantityDisplay = hasQuantity ? `<span class="item-quantity">数量: ${displayQuantity}</span>` : '';
                    const isEquipped = id ? Object.values(this.equippedItems).some(equippedItem => equippedItem && equippedItem.id === id) : false;
                    let actionButtonsHtml = '';

                    if (cat.title === '扮演法') {
                        const isEquippedAsMain = id && this.equippedItems.zhuxiuGongfa && this.equippedItems.zhuxiuGongfa.id === id;
                        const isEquippedAsAux = id && this.equippedItems.fuxiuXinfa && this.equippedItems.fuxiuXinfa.id === id;
                        actionButtonsHtml += `<div class="item-actions">`;
                        if (isEquippedAsMain) {
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-unequip-btn" data-slot-id="equip-zhuxiuGongfa">卸下</button>`;
                        } else {
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-equip-btn" data-equip-type="zhuxiu">主要</button>`;
                        }
                        if (isEquippedAsAux) {
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-unequip-btn" data-slot-id="equip-fuxiuXinfa">卸下</button>`;
                        } else {
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-equip-btn" data-equip-type="fuxiu">辅助</button>`;
                        }
                        actionButtonsHtml += `</div>`;
                    } else if (cat.equipable) {
                        actionButtonsHtml += `<div class="item-actions">`;
                        if (isEquipped) {
                            const slotKey = Object.keys(this.equippedItems).find(key => this.equippedItems[key] && this.equippedItems[key].id === id);
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-unequip-btn" data-slot-id="equip-${slotKey}">卸下</button>`;
                        } else {
                            actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-equip-btn">装备</button>`;
                        }
                        actionButtonsHtml += `<button class="item-discard-btn">丢弃</button></div>`;
                    } else if (cat.title === '消耗品') {
                        actionButtonsHtml = `<div class="item-actions"><button class="item-use-btn">使用</button><button class="item-discard-btn">丢弃</button></div>`;
                    } else {
                        actionButtonsHtml = `<div class="item-actions"><button class="item-discard-btn">丢弃</button></div>`;
                    }

                    
                    const rawDetails = this.renderItemDetailsForInventory(item);
                    const itemDetailsHtml = rawDetails ? this.formatObject(rawDetails) : '';

                    html += `
                        <div class="inventory-item" data-item-details='${itemJson}' data-category='${cat.title}'>
                             <div class="item-name-desc">
                                <span class="item-name" style="${tierStyle}">${name}</span>
                                <div class="item-description">${description}</div>
                                ${itemDetailsHtml ? `<div class="item-details">${itemDetailsHtml}</div>` : ''}
                            </div>
                            <div class="item-meta">\n                                ${tierDisplay}\n                                ${quantityDisplay}\n                                ${actionButtonsHtml}\n                            </div>\n                        </div>\n                    `;
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error('渲染物品条目失败:', item, e);
                }
            });
            html += '</div>';
        } else {
            html += '<div class="inventory-item-list"><p class="empty-category-text">空无一物</p></div>';
        }
        html += `</details>`;
    });

    return html;
},

// ====================================================================
    // 核心物品操作函数 (Equip/Unequip/Use/Discard Core Functions)
    // ====================================================================

    equipItem(item, category, buttonElement, equipType = null) {
        const itemId = this.SafeGetValue(item, 'id');
        if (!itemId || itemId === 'N/A') {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('物品无ID，无法装备。');
            return;
        }
        if (category === '扮演法') {
            const isEquippedAsMain = this.equippedItems.zhuxiuGongfa && this.equippedItems.zhuxiuGongfa.id === itemId;
            const isEquippedAsAux = this.equippedItems.fuxiuXinfa && this.equippedItems.fuxiuXinfa.id === itemId;
            if ((equipType === 'fuxiuXinfa' && isEquippedAsMain) || (equipType === 'zhuxiuGongfa' && isEquippedAsAux)) {
                this.showTemporaryMessage('该能力已被装备在另一槽位。');
                return;
            }
        }

        const categoryMap = { 武器: 'wuqi', 衣物: 'fangju', 饰品: 'shipin', 封印物: 'fabao1', 扮演法: equipType };
        const slotKey = categoryMap[category];

        if (!slotKey) {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('错误的装备分类或类型。');
            return;
        }

        const currentlyEquippedSlot = Object.keys(this.equippedItems).find(key => this.equippedItems[key] && this.equippedItems[key].id === itemId);
        if (currentlyEquippedSlot && currentlyEquippedSlot !== slotKey) {
            const oldSlotElement = document.getElementById(`equip-${currentlyEquippedSlot}`);
            if (oldSlotElement) {
                this.unequipItem(`equip-${currentlyEquippedSlot}`, oldSlotElement, false);
            }
        }

        const slotElement = document.getElementById(`equip-${slotKey}`);
        if (!slotElement) return;

        const oldItem = this.equippedItems[slotKey];
        if (oldItem) {
            this.unequipItem(`equip-${slotKey}`, slotElement, false);
        }

        this.equippedItems[slotKey] = item;
        const tier = this.SafeGetValue(item, '品阶', '普通');
        const tierStyle = this.getTierStyle(tier);
        slotElement.textContent = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
        slotElement.setAttribute('style', tierStyle);
        slotElement.classList.add('equipped');
        slotElement.dataset.itemDetails = JSON.stringify(item);

        if (buttonElement.closest('#inventory-modal')) {
            this.showInventory();
        }

        const itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
        const defaultTextMap = { wuqi: '武器', fangju: '衣物', shipin: '饰品', fabao1: '封印物', zhuxiuGongfa: '主要扮演法', fuxiuXinfa: '辅助能力' };
        const slotFriendlyName = defaultTextMap[slotKey] || category;
        this.pendingActions = this.pendingActions.filter(action => action.itemName !== itemName);
        this.pendingActions.push({ action: 'equip', itemName: itemName, category: slotFriendlyName });

        this.showTemporaryMessage(`已装备 ${this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称')}`);
        this.updateDisplayedAttributes();
        this.saveEquipmentState();
        this.savePendingActions();
    },

    unequipItem(slotId, slotElement, showMessage = true, refreshInventoryUI = true) {
        const slotKey = slotId.replace('equip-', '');
        const defaultTextMap = { wuqi: '武器', fangju: '衣物', shipin: '饰品', fabao1: '封印物', zhuxiuGongfa: '主要扮演法', fuxiuXinfa: '辅助能力' };
        const itemDataString = slotElement.dataset.itemDetails;
        if (!itemDataString) return;

        let itemName = '一件装备';
        try {
            const item = JSON.parse(itemDataString);
            itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('卸载时解析物品数据失败:', e);
        }

        this.equippedItems[slotKey] = null;
        slotElement.textContent = defaultTextMap[slotKey] || '空';
        slotElement.classList.remove('equipped');
        slotElement.removeAttribute('style');
        delete slotElement.dataset.itemDetails;

        if (refreshInventoryUI) {
            this.showInventory();
        }

        this.pendingActions = this.pendingActions.filter(action => action.itemName !== itemName);
        this.pendingActions.push({ action: 'unequip', itemName: itemName, category: defaultTextMap[slotKey] });

        if (showMessage) {
            this.showTemporaryMessage(`已卸下 ${itemName}`);
        }
        this.updateDisplayedAttributes();
        this.saveEquipmentState();
        this.savePendingActions();
    },

    useItem(item, buttonElement) {
        const itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
        if (itemName === 'N/A') {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('物品信息错误，无法使用。');
            return;
        }
        const originalQuantity = parseInt(this.SafeGetValue(item, '数量', 0), 10);
        const pendingUses = this.pendingActions.filter(action => action.action === 'use' && action.itemName === itemName).reduce((total, action) => total + action.quantity, 0);
        if (originalQuantity - pendingUses <= 0) {
            this.showTemporaryMessage(`${itemName} 已用完或已在指令队列中。`);
            return;
        }
        const existingAction = this.pendingActions.find(action => action.action === 'use' && action.itemName === itemName);
        if (existingAction) {
            existingAction.quantity++;
        } else {
            this.pendingActions.push({ action: 'use', itemName: itemName, quantity: 1 });
        }
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`已将 [使用 ${itemName}] 加入指令队列`);
        this.savePendingActions();
        this.showInventory();
    },

    discardItem(item, category, itemElement) {
        const itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
        if (itemName === 'N/A') {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('物品信息错误，无法丢弃。');
            return;
        }
        const hasQuantity = item.hasOwnProperty('数量');
        if (hasQuantity && (category === '消耗品' || category === '杂物')) {
            this.promptDiscardQuantity(item, category, itemElement);
        } else {
            this.confirmDiscardItem(item, category, itemElement, 1);
        }
    },

                   

    renderTooltipContent(item) {
    // --- 核心修正：使用中文键名 --- 
    const tier = this.SafeGetValue(item, '品阶', '普通');
    const tierStyle = this.getTierStyle(tier);
    const level = this.SafeGetValue(item, '等级', '');
    const tierDisplay = level ? `${tier} ${level}` : tier;

    let attributesHtml = '';
    const attributes = item.attributes_bonus;
    if (typeof attributes === 'object' && attributes !== null && Object.keys(attributes).length > 0) {
        attributesHtml += `<div class="tooltip-section-title">固定加成</div>`;
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
            attributesHtml += `<p><strong>${key}:</strong> ${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${value}</p>`;
        }
    }

    const percentBonuses = item['百分比加成'];
    if (typeof percentBonuses === 'object' && percentBonuses !== null && Object.keys(percentBonuses).length > 0) {
        attributesHtml += `<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top: 5px;">百分比加成</div>`;
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(percentBonuses)) {
           attributesHtml += `<p><strong>${key}:</strong> +${value}</p>`;
        }
    }

    let effectsHtml = '';
    const effects = item.special_effects;
    if (Array.isArray(effects) && effects.length > 0) {
        effectsHtml += `<div class="tooltip-section-title">特殊效果</div>`;
        effectsHtml += effects.filter(eff => eff !== '$__META_EXTENSIBLE__$').map(eff => `<p>${eff}</p>`).join('');
    }

    return `
        <div class="tooltip-title" style="${tierStyle}">${this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称')}</div>
        <p><strong>等级:</strong> ${tierDisplay}</p>
        <p><i>${this.SafeGetValue(item, '描述', '无描述')}</i></p>
        ${attributesHtml ? `<div class="tooltip-section tooltip-attributes">${attributesHtml}</div>` : ''}
        ${effectsHtml ? `<div class="tooltip-section">${effectsHtml}</div>` : ''}
    `;
    // --- 修正结束 ---
    },

    howEquipmentTooltip(element, event) {
            const tooltip = document.getElementById('equipment-tooltip');
            const itemDataString = element.dataset.itemDetails;
            if (!tooltip || !itemDataString) return;
            try {
              const item = JSON.parse(itemDataString);
              tooltip.innerHTML = this.renderTooltipContent(item);
              tooltip.style.display = 'block';
              const tooltipRect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
              const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
              const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
              let left = event.pageX + 15;
              let top = event.pageY + 15;
              if (left + tooltipRect.width > viewportWidth) {
                left = event.pageX - tooltipRect.width - 15;
              }
              if (top + tooltipRect.height > viewportHeight) {
                top = event.pageY - tooltipRect.height - 15;
              }
              tooltip.style.left = `${left}px`;
              tooltip.style.top = `${top}px`;
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('解析装备Tooltip数据失败:', e);
            }
    },

    hideEquipmentTooltip() {
            const tooltip = document.getElementById('equipment-tooltip');
            if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    },

    renderItemDetailsForInventory(item) {
    let finalHtml = '';
    
    const excludeKeys = ['名称', '描述', '数量', 'id', '品阶', '序列', 'attributes_bonus', '百分比加成', 'special_effects'];

    let topLevelStatsHtml = '';
    const topLevelStats = [];
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(item)) {
        if (!excludeKeys.includes(key)) {
            const displayValue = typeof value === 'object' && value !== null 
                ? this.formatObject(value)  // 对象转文本
                : `${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${value}`; // 非对象直接处理
            topLevelStats.push(`<strong>${key}:</strong> ${displayValue}`);
        }
    }
    if (topLevelStats.length > 0) {
        topLevelStatsHtml += '<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top: 5px;">基础属性</div>';
        topLevelStatsHtml += `<p>${topLevelStats.join(', ')}</p>`;
    }
    finalHtml += topLevelStatsHtml;

    let attributesHtml = '';
    const attributes = item.attributes_bonus;
    if (typeof attributes === 'object' && attributes !== null && Object.keys(attributes).length > 0) {
        attributesHtml += '<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top: 5px;">固定加成</div>';
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
            attributesHtml += `<p><strong>${key}:</strong> ${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${value}</p>`;
        }
    }
    finalHtml += attributesHtml;

    const percentBonuses = item['百分比加成'];
    if (typeof percentBonuses === 'object' && percentBonuses !== null && Object.keys(percentBonuses).length > 0) {
        let percentHtml = '<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top: 5px;">百分比加成</div>';
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(percentBonuses)) {
            percentHtml += `<p><strong>${key}:</strong> +${value}</p>`;
        }
        finalHtml += percentHtml;
    }

    let effectsHtml = '';
    let effects = item.special_effects;
    if (typeof effects === 'string' && effects.trim() !== '') {
        effects = effects.split('\n').map(e => e.trim()).filter(e => e);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(effects) && effects.length > 0) {
        effectsHtml += `<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top: 5px;">特殊效果</div>`;
        effectsHtml += effects.filter(eff => eff !== '$__META_EXTENSIBLE__$').map(eff => `<p>${eff}</p>`).join('');
    }
    finalHtml += effectsHtml;

    return finalHtml;
    },

          

          

async updateDisplayedAttributes(currentViewSnapshot) { 
 let targetSnapshot;
 if (currentViewSnapshot && currentViewSnapshot.data?.stat_data) {
 // 场景1：外部传入有效快照（切换回合时）
 targetSnapshot = currentViewSnapshot;
 console.log('[属性更新] 使用外部传入的当前查看回合快照');
 } else {
 // 场景2：无外部传入（读档/活跃回合更新时）
 const cacheLength = this.chatHistoryCache.length;
 if (cacheLength === 0) {
 console.warn('[属性更新] chatHistoryCache 为空，使用默认空快照');
 targetSnapshot = { data: { stat_data: {} } };
 } else {
 const currentViewIndex = this.historyViewIndex ?? (cacheLength - 1);
 const safeIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentViewIndex, cacheLength - 1));
 targetSnapshot = this.chatHistoryCache[safeIndex];
  if (!targetSnapshot) {
    console.error('[属性更新] 索引 ${safeIndex} 对应的快照不存在，使用默认空快照');
  targetSnapshot = { data: { stat_data: {} } };
  }
}
}
 if (!targetSnapshot.data) {
 targetSnapshot.data = { stat_data: {} };
 }
 if (!targetSnapshot.data.stat_data) {
 targetSnapshot.data.stat_data = {};
 }
 

 const lastSnapshot = this.chatHistoryCache.at(-1);
 const isLastSnapshotValid = !!lastSnapshot && !!lastSnapshot.message_id;
 const expectedActiveId = isLastSnapshotValid ? lastSnapshot.message_id : '';
 const isActiveRound = targetSnapshot.message_id === expectedActiveId;
 let stat_data = targetSnapshot.data.stat_data; // 先默认用快照数据
if (isActiveRound && this.currentMvuState?.stat_data) {
  stat_data = this.currentMvuState.stat_data; // 活跃回合替换成最新数据
}
  // 传入快照是最新的 → 活跃回合
 console.log(`[属性更新] 当前ID: ${targetSnapshot.message_id}，最后一条快照ID: ${lastSnapshot?.message_id || '无效'}，是否活跃: ${isActiveRound}`);
  // 1. 获取角色“裸装”基础值（严格读取快照中的基础变量，对应attributeConfig的baseVar）
  const characterBaseAttributes = {};
  this.attributeConfig.forEach(attr => {
    // 从快照读取基础值（如“基础灵性”“基础理智”等）
    characterBaseAttributes[attr.key] = Number(this.SafeGetValue(stat_data, attr.baseVar, 0));
  });
  console.log('[updateDisplayedAttributes] 读取的裸装基础值:', characterBaseAttributes);

  // 2. 初始化总加成对象（固定值加成 + 百分比加成）
  const totalFlatBonuses = { 活力: 0, 灵性: 0, 理智: 0, 人性: 0, 敏捷: 0, 运气: 0 };
  const totalPercentBonuses = { 活力: 0, 灵性: 0, 理智: 0, 人性: 0, 敏捷: 0, 运气: 0 };

  // 3. 定义加成计算函数（处理装备/天赋的复杂加成结构）
  const processBonuses = (sourceObject) => {
    if (!sourceObject || typeof sourceObject !== 'object') return;

    // 计算固定值加成（支持顶层属性和attributes_bonus口袋）
    for (const key in totalFlatBonuses) {
      let bonus = 0;
      const baseBonusKey = `基础${key}加成`;
      const flatBonusKey = `${key}加成`;
      const simpleKey = key.replace('值', '');
      const baseSimpleKey = `基础${simpleKey}加成`;
      // 从顶层属性读取加成（如“灵性加成”“基础灵性加成”）
      bonus += Number(this.SafeGetValue(sourceObject, [baseBonusKey, flatBonusKey, baseSimpleKey, key], 0));
      // 从attributes_bonus口袋读取加成（如装备的attributes_bonus.灵性）
      const attributesBonusObj = this.SafeGetValue(sourceObject, 'attributes_bonus', null);
      if (attributesBonusObj && typeof attributesBonusObj === 'object') {
        bonus += Number(this.SafeGetValue(attributesBonusObj, key, 0));
      }
      if (!isNaN(bonus)) totalFlatBonuses[key] += bonus;
    }

    // 计算百分比加成（支持“全部属性”和单个属性）
    const percentBonusObject = this.SafeGetValue(sourceObject, '百分比加成', {});
    if (typeof percentBonusObject === 'object') {
      const allBonusValue = parseFloat(this.SafeGetValue(percentBonusObject, '全部属性', '0%'));
      for (const key in totalPercentBonuses) {
        const specificBonusValue = parseFloat(this.SafeGetValue(percentBonusObject, key, '0%'));
        totalPercentBonuses[key] += allBonusValue + specificBonusValue; // 合并全部属性和单个属性加成
      }
    }
  };

  // 3a. 计算装备加成（强制用当前查看回合的装备）
  Object.values(this.equippedItems).forEach(item => processBonuses(item));
  // 3b. 计算天赋加成（遍历用目标快照的非凡特性列表）
  const talents = Object.values(this.SafeGetValue(stat_data, '非凡特性列表', {}));
  console.log('--- 开始处理天赋加成 ---');
  talents.forEach(talent => {
    //console.log(' 正在处理天赋:', talent);
    processBonuses(talent);
  });
  console.log('--- 天赋加成处理完毕 ---');
  console.log('[属性更新] 计算前总加成:', { totalFlatBonuses, totalPercentBonuses });

  // 4. 计算最终属性上限值（核心公式：(基础值 + 固定加成) * (1 + 百分比加成)）
  this.calculatedMaxAttributes = {};
  const variablesToUpdate = {}; // 存储需要更新到快照的上限值
  for (const key in totalFlatBonuses) {
      const base = Number(characterBaseAttributes[key] || 0);
    const flat = totalFlatBonuses[key] || 0;
    const percent = totalPercentBonuses[key] / 100 || 0;
    console.log(`[属性质检] ${key} | 基础值: ${base} | 固定加成: ${flat} | 百分比加成: ${percent*100}%`);
    
    // 计算并修正无效值（避免NaN）
    const maxVal = Math.round((base + flat) * (1 + percent));
    this.calculatedMaxAttributes[key] = isNaN(maxVal) ? base : maxVal;
    variablesToUpdate[key] = isNaN(maxVal) ? base : maxVal; // 只更新五大属性的上限值
  }

  // 5. 同步到快照并保存（只在六大属性变化时“活跃回合”执行快照覆盖和保存保存）
  if (isActiveRound) { 
 try {
 
    // 对比快照中旧的上限值和新计算的上限值
    const coreAttributes = this.attributeConfig.map(attr => attr.key); // 从attributeConfig获取五大属性key
    const oldValues = {};
    const newValues = {};
    coreAttributes.forEach(attr => {
      oldValues[attr] = Number(lastSnapshot.data.stat_data[attr] || 0); // 当前快照旧值
      newValues[attr] = Number(this.calculatedMaxAttributes[attr] || 0); // 新计算值
    });

    // 判断是否需要保存（只要有一个属性变化就保存）
    const needSave = coreAttributes.some(attr => Math.abs(newValues[attr] - oldValues[attr]) > 0);
    if (needSave) {
      // 强制用计算出的上限值覆盖快照中的旧值（忽略AI可能的乱改）
      lastSnapshot.data.stat_data = {
        ...lastSnapshot.data.stat_data, // 保留基础值、当前值、天赋等其他数据
        ...variablesToUpdate // 覆盖六大属性的上限值（计算结果优先）
      };
      // 更新内存中的currentMvuState
      this.currentMvuState.stat_data = { ...lastSnapshot.data.stat_data };
      // 保存到本地缓存
      await AppStorage.saveData(this._getHistoryKey(), this.chatHistoryCache);
      console.log('[属性更新] 活跃回合属性变动，已保存快照', { 旧值: oldValues, 新值: newValues });
    } else {
      console.log('[属性更新] 活跃回合属性无变动，跳过保存');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[属性更新] 活跃回合快照保存失败:', e.message);
  }
} else {
 // 历史回合：只更新UI，不修改任何快照数据
 console.log('[属性更新] 历史回合属性计算完成，仅更新UI，不保存快照');
  }
  // 6. 更新UI显示（严格按照attributeConfig映射，显示当前值/上限值）
  console.log('[属性更新] 计算完毕，最终上限值:', this.calculatedMaxAttributes);
  const updateText = (elId, current, max) => {

    if (el) el.innerText = `${current} / ${max}`;

  const updateSingleValueText = (elId, value) => {

      updateText(`attr-${attr.uiId}`, Math.min(currentVal, maxVal), maxVal); // 确保当前值不超过上限
    }

  // 更新非核心属性UI（年龄相关）
  updateSingleValueText(

  );
 const campParent = stat_data.阵营 || {};
 const allCamps = Object.entries(campParent)
    .filter(([key]) => key !== '$meta')
    .map(([originalKey, data]) => ({ 
      ...data,

 const campSwitcher = document.getElementById('camp-select');

  }

  //  2. 定义“更新当前阵营属性”的通用函数（切换时复用）
  const updateCampAttributes = (selectedCamp) => {
    if (!selectedCamp) {
      // 无阵营时，所有属性显示默认值
      updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-name', noCampTips);

    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-resources', '无');

    // 有阵营时，更新对应属性

    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-position', selectedCamp.职位 || '无');

    const influence = typeof selectedCamp.影响力 === 'number' ? Math.min(selectedCamp.影响力, 100) : 0;
    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-influence', `${influence}/100`);
    
    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-nature', selectedCamp.阵营性质 || '中立');
    
    const reputation = typeof selectedCamp.声望 === 'number' ? Math.min(selectedCamp.声望, 100000) : 0;
    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-reputation', `${reputation}`);
    
    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-core', selectedCamp.核心成员 || '无');
    updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-task', selectedCamp.当前任务 || '无');

    const campResources = selectedCamp.阵营资源 || {};
    const resourceEntries = Object.entries(campResources);
  
    if (resourceEntries.length > 0) {

      updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-resources', resourceText);
    } else {

      updateSingleValueText('attr-camp-resources', '无');

  //  3. 初始显示（默认选中第一个阵营，无阵营则显示提示）
  const initialCamp = allCamps[0] || null;

  //  4. 绑定下拉菜单切换事件（多阵营时生效）
  campSwitcher.onchange = (e) => {
    const selectedKey = e.target.value;

    const selectedCamp = allCamps.find(camp => camp.originalKey === selectedKey);

          showCommandCenter() {

              let actionText = '';
              switch (cmd.action) {
                case 'equip': actionText = `[装备] ${cmd.itemName} 到 ${cmd.category}`;
                  break;
                case 'unequip': actionText = `[卸下] ${cmd.itemName} 从 ${cmd.category}`;
                  break;
                case 'use': actionText = `[使用] ${cmd.itemName} x ${cmd.quantity}`;
                  break;
                case 'discard':

                  } else {
                    actionText = `[丢弃] ${cmd.itemName}`;

            });
            html += '</ul>';

          async promptDiscardQuantity(item, category, itemElement) {
            const itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
            const currentQuantity = parseInt(this.SafeGetValue(item, '数量', 0), 10);
            const pendingUses = this.pendingActions.filter(a => a.action === 'use' && a.itemName === itemName).reduce((t, a) => t + a.quantity, 0);
            const pendingDiscards = this.pendingActions.filter(a => a.action === 'discard' && a.itemName === itemName).reduce((t, a) => t + a.quantity, 0);
            const availableQuantity = currentQuantity - pendingUses - pendingDiscards;
            if (availableQuantity <= 0) {
              this.showTemporaryMessage(`${itemName} 没有可丢弃的数量。`);
              return;
            }

            return new Promise((resolve) => {
              const modal = document.createElement('div');
              modal.className = 'modal-overlay';
              modal.style.display = 'flex';
              modal.style.zIndex = '2000';
              modal.innerHTML = `
                <div class="modal-content" style="width: 400px; height: auto; max-height: none;">
                  <div class="modal-header"><h2 class="modal-title">丢弃物品</h2></div>
                  <div class="modal-body" style="padding: 20px;">
                    <p style="margin-bottom: 15px; color: #d2b48c;">请输入要丢弃的 <strong>${itemName}</strong> 数量：</p>
                    <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #a09c91; margin-bottom: 10px;">当前可丢弃数量：${availableQuantity}</p>
                    <input type="number" id="discard-quantity-input" min="1" max="${availableQuantity}" value="1"
                           style="width: 100%; padding: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid #a09c91; color: #f5deb3; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: flex-end;">
                      <button id="discard-quantity-cancel" class="interaction-btn">取消</button>
                      <button id="discard-quantity-confirm" class="interaction-btn" style="background: #8b0000; border-color: #ff6b6b;">确认丢弃</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              `;
              document.querySelector('.guixu-root-container').appendChild(modal);
              const input = modal.querySelector('#discard-quantity-input');
              const confirmBtn = modal.querySelector('#discard-quantity-confirm');
              const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('#discard-quantity-cancel');
              confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const quantity = parseInt(input.value, 10);
                if (isNaN(quantity) || quantity <= 0 || quantity > availableQuantity) {
                  this.showTemporaryMessage('请输入有效的丢弃数量');
                  return;
                }
                modal.remove();
                this.confirmDiscardItem(item, category, itemElement, quantity);
                resolve();
              });
              cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { modal.remove(); resolve(); });
              setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 100);
            });
          },

          confirmDiscardItem(item, category, itemElement, quantity = 1) {
            const itemName = this.SafeGetValue(item, '名称');
            const hasQuantity = item.hasOwnProperty('数量');
            let confirmMessage = hasQuantity ? `确定要丢弃 ${quantity} 个 ${itemName} 吗？此操作不可恢复。` : `确定要丢弃 ${itemName} 吗？此操作不可恢复。`;
            this.showCustomConfirm(confirmMessage, () => {
              this.pendingActions.push({ action: 'discard', itemName: itemName, category: category, quantity: quantity });
              this.savePendingActions();
              this.showInventory();
              this.showTemporaryMessage(`已将 [丢弃 ${itemName}] 加入指令队列`);
            });
          },

// 保存用户勾选的修剪字段

// 将事件对象数组重新构建为世界书内容的字符串格式
 _extractJourneyTitlesFromHistory(historyArray) {
    if (!historyArray || historyArray.length === 0) return [];
    const titles = [];
    historyArray.forEach((snapshot, index) => {
        const journeyText = this._extractLastTagContent('本周目经历', snapshot.message);
        //console.log(`[提取验证] 快照${index}的journeyText:`, journeyText ? '非空' : '空', journeyText?.substring(0, 50));
        if (journeyText) {
            const events = this.parseJourneyEntry(journeyText);
            if (events.length > 0) {
                const lastEvent = events[events.length - 1];
                titles.push({
                    title: `[${lastEvent['序号']}] ${lastEvent['标题'] || '无标题事件'}`,
                    historyIndex: index // 记录这个事件在历史数组中的索引
                });
            }
        }
    });
    return titles;
},
  reconstructJourneyEntry(events) {
    if (!Array.isArray(events)) return '';
    return events.map(event => this.stringifyJourneyEvent(event)).join('\n\n');
},

// “精确修剪”按钮的执行逻辑
handlePreciseTrim() {
    const checkedBoxes = document.querySelectorAll('#history-modal-body .journey-trim-checkbox:checked');
    if (checkedBoxes.length === 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('请先在下方历程中勾选需要修剪的条目。');
        return;
    }
    const sequenceIdsToTrim = Array.from(checkedBoxes).map(box => box.dataset.sequenceId);
    const fieldsToRemove = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.trim-field-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
    if (fieldsToRemove.length === 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('请先在上方控制台勾选需要修剪的字段。');
        return;
    }
    this.showCustomConfirm(
        `你确定要从选中的 ${checkedBoxes.length} 个条目中，删除【${fieldsToRemove.join('、')}】字段吗？此操作不可恢复。`,
        async () => {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('正在进行精确修剪...');
            const bookName = '1源堡';
            const index = this.unifiedIndex;
            const journeyKey = index > 1 ? `本周目经历(${index})` : '本周目经历';
            try {
                const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                const journeyEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === journeyKey);
                if (!journeyEntry || !journeyEntry.content) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('错误：找不到“本周目经历”内容。');
                    return;
                }
                let events = this.parseJourneyEntry(journeyEntry.content);
                let trimCount = 0;
                events.forEach(event => {
                    if (sequenceIdsToTrim.includes(event['序号'])) {
                        let trimmedThisEvent = false;
                        fieldsToRemove.forEach(field => {
                            if (event.hasOwnProperty(field)) {
                                delete event[field];
                                trimmedThisEvent = true;
                            }
                        });
                        if (trimmedThisEvent) trimCount++;
                    }
                });
                if (trimCount === 0) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('选中的条目中没有可修剪的内容。');
                    return;
                }
                const newContent = this.reconstructJourneyEntry(events);
                await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, [{ uid: journeyEntry.uid, content: newContent }]);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`修剪成功！已处理 ${trimCount} 个条目。`, 3000);
                this.showJourney(); // 刷新视图
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('精确修剪失败:', error);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`修剪失败: ${error.message}`, 3000);
            }
        },
        true
    );
},

// “自动修剪”按钮的执行逻辑
handleAutoTrim() {
    const fieldsToRemove = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.trim-field-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
    if (fieldsToRemove.length === 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('请先在上方控制台勾选需要修剪的字段。');
        return;
    }
    const keepCountInput = document.getElementById('trim-keep-count');
    const keepCount = parseInt(keepCountInput.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(keepCount) || keepCount < 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('请输入有效的保留数量。');
        return;
    }
    this.showCustomConfirm(
        `你确定要保留最新的 ${keepCount} 个条目，并从所有更早的条目中删除【${fieldsToRemove.join('、')}】字段吗？此操作不可恢复。`,
        async () => {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('正在进行自动修剪...');
            const bookName = '1源堡';
            const index = this.unifiedIndex;
            const journeyKey = index > 1 ? `本周目经历(${index})` : '本周目经历';
            try {
                const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                const journeyEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === journeyKey);
                if (!journeyEntry || !journeyEntry.content) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('错误：找不到“本周目经历”内容。');
                    return;
                }
                let events = this.parseJourneyEntry(journeyEntry.content);
                if (events.length <= keepCount) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('无需修剪，当前条目数未超过保留数量。');
                    return;
                }
                let trimCount = 0;
                const eventsToTrimCount = events.length - keepCount;
                events.forEach((event, idx) => {
                    if (idx < eventsToTrimCount) {
                        let trimmedThisEvent = false;
                        fieldsToRemove.forEach(field => {
                            if (event.hasOwnProperty(field)) {
                                delete event[field];
                                trimmedThisEvent = true;
                            }
                        });
                        if (trimmedThisEvent) trimCount++;
                    }
                });
                if (trimCount === 0) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('没有可修剪的内容。');
                    return;
                }
                const newContent = this.reconstructJourneyEntry(events);
                await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, [{ uid: journeyEntry.uid, content: newContent }]);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`自动修剪成功！已处理 ${trimCount} 个旧条目。`, 3000);
                this.showJourney();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('自动修剪失败:', error);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`修剪失败: ${error.message}`, 3000);
            }
        },
        true
    );

// “永久删除”按钮的执行逻辑
handleFullTrim() {
    const keepCountInput = document.getElementById('trim-keep-count');
    const keepCount = parseInt(keepCountInput.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(keepCount) || keepCount < 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('请输入有效的保留数量。');
        return;
    }
    this.showCustomConfirm(
        `【高危操作】你确定要永久删除除最近 ${keepCount} 条外的所有历程记录吗？此操作将彻底删除数据，不可恢复！`,
        async () => {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('正在进行完整删除...');
            const bookName = '1源堡';
            const index = this.unifiedIndex;
            const journeyKey = index > 1 ? `本周目经历(${index})` : '本周目经历';
            try {
                const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                const journeyEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === journeyKey);
                if (!journeyEntry || !journeyEntry.content) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('错误：找不到“本周目经历”内容。');
                    return;
                }
                let events = this.parseJourneyEntry(journeyEntry.content);
                if (events.length <= keepCount) {
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('无需删除，当前条目数未超过保留数量。');
                    return;
                }
                const deletedCount = events.length - keepCount;
                const keptEvents = events.slice(deletedCount);
                const newContent = this.reconstructJourneyEntry(keptEvents);
                await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, [{ uid: journeyEntry.uid, content: newContent }]);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`完整删除成功！已删除 ${deletedCount} 个旧条目。`, 3000);
                this.showJourney();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('完整删除失败:', error);
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`删除失败: ${error.message}`, 3000);
            }
        },
        true
    );
},

          parseJourneyEntry(contentString) {
    if (!contentString || typeof contentString !== 'string') return [];
    try {
        const events = [];
        // 修正：使用更可靠的正则表达式按“序号|”分割事件块
        const eventBlocks = contentString.trim().split(/\n*\s*序号\|/).filter(s => s.trim() !== '');

        const fieldOrder = ['日期', '标题', '地点', '人物', '描述', '人物关系', '标签', '重要信息', '暗线与伏笔', '自动化系统'];
        
        eventBlocks.forEach((block, index) => {
            // 修正：从块的开头直接解析序号，而不是依赖文件名
            const firstLineEnd = block.indexOf('\n');
            const seq = block.substring(0, firstLineEnd !== -1 ? firstLineEnd : undefined).trim();
            if (!/\d+/.test(seq)) return; // 如果第一行不是有效的序号，则跳过此块

            const event = { '序号': seq };
            let remainingBlock = firstLineEnd !== -1 ? block.substring(firstLineEnd).trim() : '';

            // 修正：逐行解析，而不是使用复杂的正则表达式
            const lines = remainingBlock.split('\n');
            let currentKey = null;
            for (const line of lines) {
                let matched = false;
                for (const key of fieldOrder) {
                    if (line.startsWith(key + '|')) {
                        if (currentKey && event[currentKey] === undefined) {
                           event[currentKey] = ''; // 如果上一个key没有值，则赋空字符串
                        }
                        currentKey = key;
                        event[currentKey] = line.substring(key.length + 1).trim();
                        matched = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!matched && currentKey && event[currentKey] !== undefined) {
                    event[currentKey] += '\n' + line;
                }
            }
            events.push(event);
        });

        return events;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('解析“本周目经历”时出错:', e);
        return [];
    }
},
  stringifyJourneyEvent(event) {
    const fieldOrder = ['序号', '日期', '标题', '地点', '人物', '描述', '人物关系', '标签', '重要信息', '暗线与伏笔', '自动化系统'];
    return fieldOrder
        .map(key => event[key] ? `${key}|${event[key]}` : null)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join('\n');
},

          parsePastLifeEntry(contentString) {
            if (!contentString || typeof contentString !== 'string') return {};
            try {
              const data = {};
              const lines = contentString.trim().split('\n');
              lines.forEach(line => {
                const parts = line.split('|');
                if (parts.length >= 2) {
                  const key = parts[0].trim();
                  const value = parts.slice(1).join('|').trim();
                  data[key] = value;
                }
              });
              return data;
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('解析历史投影失败:', e);
              return {};
            }
          },

          async writeToLorebook(baseEntryKey, contentToWrite, silent = false) {
    if (!contentToWrite || contentToWrite.trim() === '') {
        if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage('没有可写入的内容。');
        return;
    }

    const index = this.unifiedIndex;
    const finalEntryKey = index > 1 ? `${baseEntryKey}(${index})` : baseEntryKey;
    const bookName = '1源堡';
    const reformattedContent = contentToWrite.trim();

    try {
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
        let targetEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === finalEntryKey);

        // 如果条目不存在，则创建它
        if (!targetEntry) {
            if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`条目 \"${finalEntryKey}\" 不存在，正在创建...`);
            const baseEntryTemplate = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === baseEntryKey);
            const newEntryData = {
                comment: finalEntryKey, content: reformattedContent,
                keys: baseEntryTemplate ? [...baseEntryTemplate.keys, finalEntryKey] : [finalEntryKey],
                enabled: false, selective: baseEntryTemplate?.selective, constant: baseEntryTemplate?.constant,
                position: baseEntryTemplate?.position, case_sensitive: baseEntryTemplate?.case_sensitive,
            };
            await TavernHelper.createLorebookEntries(bookName, [newEntryData]);
            if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`已创建并写入到“${finalEntryKey}”。`);
            if (this.isAutoToggleLorebookEnabled) this.updateAutoToggledEntries();
            return;
        }

        // 如果条目已存在，执行更新或追加逻辑
        const existingContent = targetEntry.content || '';
        let finalContent = '';

        if (baseEntryKey === '本周目经历') {
            const existingEvents = this.parseJourneyEntry(existingContent);
            const newEvents = this.parseJourneyEntry(reformattedContent);
            if (newEvents.length === 0) return;
            const newEvent = newEvents[0];
            const newEventId = newEvent['序号'];
            const eventIndex = existingEvents.findIndex(event => event['序号'] === newEventId);
            if (eventIndex !== -1) {
                existingEvents[eventIndex] = newEvent;
                if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`已更新事件 #${newEventId}。`);
            } else {
                existingEvents.push(newEvent);
                if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`已追加新事件 #${newEventId}。`);
            }
            existingEvents.sort((a, b) => (parseInt(a.序号, 10) || 0) - (parseInt(b.序号, 10) || 0));
            finalContent = existingEvents.map(ev => this.stringifyJourneyEvent(ev)).join('\n\n');
        } else if (baseEntryKey === '本周目核心记忆' || baseEntryKey === '当前线索') {
            // 【新增逻辑】对于核心记忆和线索，执行覆盖式更新
            finalContent = reformattedContent;
            if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`已更新“${finalEntryKey}”。`);
        } else {
            // 【保留】对于其他条目（如历史的投影），执行追加逻辑
            if (existingContent.includes(reformattedContent)) {
              if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage('内容已存在，无需重复写入。');
              return;
            }
            finalContent = existingContent + (existingContent ? '\n\n' : '') + reformattedContent;
            if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`已追加内容到“${finalEntryKey}”。`);
        }

        // 将最终构建好的内容写回世界书
        await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, [{ uid: targetEntry.uid, content: finalContent }]);

    } catch (error) {
        console.error(`写入世界书 \"${finalEntryKey}\" 时出错:`, error);
        if (!silent) this.showTemporaryMessage(`写入失败: ${error.message}`);
    }
},

          async loadAndDisplayCurrentScene(messageOrText = null) {

        let contentToParse = null;

            contentToParse = messageOrText;

                thinkingBtn.style.display = this.lastExtractedThinking ? 'flex' : 'none';

            this.hideThinkingOverlay();

          async updateAutoToggledEntries(andDisableAll = false) {
            const bookName = '1源堡';
            const index = this.unifiedIndex;
            const journeyKey = index > 1 ? `本周目经历(${index})` : '本周目经历';
            const pastLivesKey = index > 1 ? `历史的投影(${index})` : '历史的投影';
            try {
                let allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                const entriesToCreate = [];
                const targetJourneyEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === journeyKey);
                if (!targetJourneyEntry) {
                    const baseTemplate = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === '本周目经历');
                    if (baseTemplate) {
                        const newJourneyEntry = { ...baseTemplate };
                        delete newJourneyEntry.uid;
                        newJourneyEntry.comment = journeyKey; newJourneyEntry.content = '';
                        newJourneyEntry.keys = [...(baseTemplate.keys || []), journeyKey];
                        newJourneyEntry.enabled = true; newJourneyEntry.position = 'before_character_definition';
                        newJourneyEntry.order = 20;
                        entriesToCreate.push(newJourneyEntry);
                    }
                }
                const targetPastLivesEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === pastLivesKey);
                if (!targetPastLivesEntry) {
                    const baseTemplate = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === '历史的投影');
                    if (baseTemplate) {
                        const newPastLivesEntry = { ...baseTemplate };
                        delete newPastLivesEntry.uid;
                        newPastLivesEntry.comment = pastLivesKey; newPastLivesEntry.content = '';
                        newPastLivesEntry.keys = [...(baseTemplate.keys || []), pastLivesKey];
                        newPastLivesEntry.enabled = true; newPastLivesEntry.position = 'before_character_definition';
                        newPastLivesEntry.order = 19;
                        entriesToCreate.push(newPastLivesEntry);
                    }
                }
                if (entriesToCreate.length > 0) {
                    await TavernHelper.createLorebookEntries(bookName, entriesToCreate);
                    console.log(`[源堡自动开关] 已自动创建 ${entriesToCreate.length} 个新世界书条目。`);
                    allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                }
                const entriesToUpdate = [];
                for (const entry of allEntries) {
                    const isJourneyEntry = entry.comment.startsWith('本周目经历');
                    const isPastLivesEntry = entry.comment.startsWith('历史的投影');
                    if (!isJourneyEntry && !isPastLivesEntry) continue;
                    const isTarget = entry.comment === journeyKey || entry.comment === pastLivesKey;
                    const shouldBeEnabled = isTarget && !andDisableAll;
                    if (entry.enabled !== shouldBeEnabled) {
                        entriesToUpdate.push({ uid: entry.uid, enabled: shouldBeEnabled });
                    }
                }
                if (entriesToUpdate.length > 0) {
                    await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, entriesToUpdate);
                    console.log(`[源堡自动开关] 更新了 ${entriesToUpdate.length} 个世界书条目状态。`);

     async startStreamingMirror(targetDisplayElement) {
            console.log('[源堡-镜像] 启动镜像流程，开始轮询查找原生UI元素...');
            const selector = '.last_mes .mes_text'; // 我们要寻找的目标选择器

            // 这是一个持续尝试寻找目标元素的Promise
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const timeout = 20000; // 最长等待20秒
                const pollInterval = 100; // 每0.1秒检查一次
                let elapsedTime = 0;

                const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
                    const nativeChatOutput = document.querySelector(selector);

                    if (nativeChatOutput) {
                        // 找到了！停止轮询，启动观测器
                        clearInterval(intervalId);

                        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
                            if (this.isBusy) {
                                this.hideWaitingMessage();
                                targetDisplayElement.innerHTML = nativeChatOutput.innerHTML;
                            }
                        });

                        observer.observe(nativeChatOutput, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
                        resolve(observer); // 将观测器实例返回给主流程
                    } else {
                        // 还没找到，继续等待
                        elapsedTime += pollInterval;
                        if (elapsedTime >= timeout) {
                            clearInterval(intervalId);
                            console.error(`[源堡-镜像] 致命错误：轮询${timeout/1000}秒后，仍未能找到原生聊天输出元素 (${selector})。`);

 // --- 终极解决方案：动态关联性记忆系统 ---

// 1. “记忆组装”核心函数
async _assembleDynamicContext(userMessage) {
    let contextParts = [];
    let memoryParts = []; 
    const stat_data = this.currentMvuState?.stat_data;
    if (!stat_data) return '';
    const statusBlock = this._createCurrentStatusBlock();
    if (statusBlock) {
    contextParts.push(statusBlock);
    }
    // [短期记忆]：自动提取事件，放入 memoryParts
    try {
        const bookName = '1源堡';
        const index = this.unifiedIndex;
        const journeyKey = index > 1 ? `本周目经历(${index})` : '本周目经历';
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
        const journeyEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === journeyKey);

        if (journeyEntry && journeyEntry.content) {
            const events = this.parseJourneyEntry(journeyEntry.content);
            if (events.length > 0) {
                const recentEvents = events.slice(-this.recentEventsCount); // 只取最后5个
                const recentEventsText = this.reconstructJourneyEntry(recentEvents);
                memoryParts.push(`[近期发生的几件事，已按序号区分顺序]\n${recentEventsText}`);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[记忆系统] 提取短期记忆时出错:', e);
    }

    // [动态人物档案]：自动筛选并生成相关人物的档案
    try {
        const relationships = this.SafeGetValue(stat_data, '人物关系列表', {});
        const allCharacters = Object.entries(relationships).filter(([name, details]) => name !== '$meta' && typeof details === 'object');
        
        const relevantCharacters = new Map(); // 使用Map确保角色不重复

        // 筛选标准1：被标记为“重要”的人物
        allCharacters
            .filter(([name, details]) => details.isImportant === true)
            .forEach(([name, details]) => relevantCharacters.set(name, details));

        // 筛选标准2：在最近的对话中被提及的人物
        const lastAiResponse = (await getChatMessages('0'))?.[0]?.message || '';
        const textToScan = `${userMessage} ${this._getDisplayText(lastAiResponse)}`;
        
        allCharacters.forEach(([name, details]) => {
            if (textToScan.includes(name)) {
                relevantCharacters.set(name, details);
            }
        });
        
        // (可选) 筛选标准3：在场的任务 (如果未来您的变量中增加了“当前位置”)
        // const playerLocation = this.SafeGetValue(stat_data, '当前位置', null); ...

        // 组装人物档案文本
        if (relevantCharacters.size > 0) {
            let dossierText = '[当前相关人物档案]\n';
            for (const [name, details] of relevantCharacters.entries()) {
                const relationship = this.SafeGetValue(details, '关系', '未知');
                const favorability = this.SafeGetValue(details, '好感度', '未知');
                const lastEventKey = details.事件历史 ? Object.keys(details.事件历史).sort().pop() : null;
                const lastEvent = lastEventKey ? details.事件历史[lastEventKey].substring(0, 50) + '...' : '暂无记录';
                dossierText += `- ${name}: 关系(${relationship}), 好感度(${favorability}). 最新动态: ${lastEvent}\n`;
            }
            memoryParts.push(dossierText);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[记忆系统] 生成动态人物档案时出错:', e);
    }

    // [核心剧情摘要] & [当前线索] (如果存在)
    try {
        const bookName = '1源堡';
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
        const coreMemoryEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === '本周目核心记忆');
        const cluesEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === '当前线索');

        if (coreMemoryEntry && coreMemoryEntry.content) {
            memoryParts.push(`[核心剧情摘要]\n${coreMemoryEntry.content}`);
        }
        if (cluesEntry && cluesEntry.content) {
            memoryParts.push(`[当前待办线索]\n${cluesEntry.content}`);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[记忆系统] 提取核心记忆与线索时出错:', e);
    }
    
    if (memoryParts.length > 0) {
        // 记忆内容首尾加标记，说明是“之前发生的事情”
        const markedMemory = [
            '[以下是之前发生的事情（供参考，非本轮新发生内容）]',
            ...memoryParts,
            '[以上是之前发生的事情（记忆内容已结束）]'
        ];
        // 将带标记的记忆，追加到判定属性后面
        contextParts.push(...markedMemory);
    }
    
    // 返回最终组合好的、高度浓缩的记忆备忘录
    return contextParts.join('\n\n');
},

 async _applyUpdateFallback(script, currentMvuState) { // 改为async，处理路径提取
  console.log('[_applyUpdateFallback] 函数已触发！script长度:', script.length); 
  if (!script || !currentMvuState) return null;
  
  const newState = _.cloneDeep(currentMvuState);
  let modified = false; // 只要有一条正确指令生效，就为true
  this.errorCommands = [];
  const commands = this._extractCommands(script);


  // 定义数值限制规则（字段名匹配+上下限）
  const valueLimitRules = {
    好感度: { min: -200, max: 200 },    // 好感度±200
    消化进度: { min: 0, max: 100 },     // 消化进度0-100
    失控进度: { min: 0, max: 100 }      // 失控进度0-100
  };

  // 辅助函数 - 检测路径是否匹配限制字段，返回修正后的值
  const getLimitedValue = (path, value) => {
    // 提取路径最后一段（字段名，如“人物关系列表.老海格.好感度”→“好感度”）
    const fieldName = path.split('.').pop();
    // 匹配限制规则
    const rule = valueLimitRules[fieldName];
    if (!rule || typeof value !== 'number' || isNaN(value)) {
      return value; // 非限制字段/非数字，返回原值
    }
    // 强制修正到合法范围
    const limitedValue = Math.max(rule.min, Math.min(rule.max, value));
    // 超出范围时输出日志提示
    if (limitedValue !== value) {
      console.log(`[数值限制] ${fieldName}超出范围(${value})，已修正为${limitedValue}`);
    }
    return limitedValue;
  };


  // 【关键1：动态提取合法顶层路径（从newState.stat_data获取，与InitVar一致）】
  // 排除元数据$meta，其余顶层键均为合法路径（如“武器”“非凡特性列表”等）
  const legalTopPaths = Object.keys(newState.stat_data).filter(key => key !== '$meta');
  //console.log('[合法顶层路径]', legalTopPaths);

  console.log('[_applyUpdateFallback] 解析到的指令数量:', commands.length);
  if (commands.length > 0) console.log('[_applyUpdateFallback] 第一条指令:', commands[0]); 

  for (const command of commands) {
    let skip = false;
    try {
      const args = command.args.map(arg => this._trimQuotes(arg));
      // 提取指令的目标顶层路径（用于后续校验）
      const targetPath = command.command === 'set' ? args[0] : 
                         command.command === 'add' ? args[0] : 
                         command.command === 'remove' ? args[0] : 
                         command.command === 'assign' || command.command === 'insert' ? args[0] : '';
      const topPath = targetPath ? targetPath.split('.')[0] : ''; // 拆分顶层路径（如“装备栏.武器”→“装备栏”）

      switch (command.command) {
        // 1. set指令：校验顶层路径+设置结果
        case 'set':
          if (args.length < 2) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${args[0] || ''}"...)：参数不足`);
            break;
          }
          const setPath = args[0];
          let setVal = this._parseCommandValue(args[1]);
          setVal = getLimitedValue(setPath, setVal);
          
          // 校验1：顶层路径是否合法
          if (!legalTopPaths.includes(topPath)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${setPath}", "${setVal}")：非法顶层路径「${topPath}」`);
            break;
          }

          console.log(`[set指令] 处理后路径: ${setPath}，类型: ${typeof setPath}，目标键:`, newState.stat_data[setPath]);
          _.set(newState.stat_data, setPath, setVal);
          const setResult = _.get(newState.stat_data, setPath);

          // 校验2：非空值设置后是否成功（排除合法设空场景）
          if (setVal !== null && setVal !== undefined && setResult === undefined) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${setPath}", "${setVal}")：路径不存在，设置失败`);
            break;
          }

          console.log(`[set指令后] ${setPath}=${setVal}，实际值:`, setResult);
          modified = true;
          break;

        // 2. add指令：校验顶层路径+数字合法性
        case 'add':
          if (args.length < 2) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${args[0] || ''}"...)：参数不足（需路径+增减值）`);
            break;
          }
          const addPath = args[0];
          const delta = Number(this._parseCommandValue(args[1]));
          
          // 校验1：顶层路径是否合法
          if (!legalTopPaths.includes(topPath)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${addPath}", "${args[1]}")：非法顶层路径「${topPath}」`);
            break;
          }

          // 校验2：增减值是否为数字
          if (isNaN(delta)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${addPath}", "${args[1]}")：增减值非数字`);
            break;
          }

          const currentVal = _.get(newState.stat_data, addPath, 0);
          let newValue = currentVal + delta;
          newValue = getLimitedValue(addPath, newValue);
          _.set(newState.stat_data, addPath, newValue);
          console.log(`[add指令后] ${addPath}=${currentVal} + ${delta} = ${currentVal + delta}`);
          modified = true;
          break;

        // 3. remove指令：保留原有校验+叠加顶层路径校验
        case 'remove':
          if (args.length < 1) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}(...)：参数不足（需路径）`);
            break;
          }
          const removePath = args[0];
          
          // 校验1：路径是否含“.”（精确到条目）
          if (!removePath.includes(".")) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${removePath}")：路径需含“列表.条目”（如“非凡特性列表.条目1”）`);
            break;
          }

          // 校验2：顶层路径是否合法
          if (!legalTopPaths.includes(topPath)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${removePath}")：非法顶层路径「${topPath}」`);
            break;
          }

          // 校验3：路径是否存在
          if (!_.has(newState.stat_data, removePath)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${removePath}")：路径不存在`);
            break;
          }

          _.unset(newState.stat_data, removePath);
          console.log(`[remove指令后] 已删除路径: ${removePath}`);
          modified = true;
          break;

        // 4. assign/insert指令：校验顶层路径+格式合法性
        case 'assign':
        case 'insert':
          if (args.length < 2) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${args[0] || ''}"...)：参数不足（需目标路径+值/条目名+值）`);
            break;
          }
          const keyOrPath = args[0];
          let entryName = args.length >= 3 ? args[1] : "";
          let valueToAssign = this._parseCommandValue(args.length >= 3 ? args[2] : args[1]);
          
          // 校验1：顶层路径是否合法（keyOrPath可能是顶层路径或子路径）
          if (!legalTopPaths.includes(topPath)) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${keyOrPath}", ...)：非法顶层路径「${topPath}」`);
            skip = true;
            break;
          }

          // 格式修复：JSON字符串→对象
          if (typeof valueToAssign === "string" && valueToAssign.trim().startsWith("{")) {
            try {
              valueToAssign = JSON.parse(valueToAssign);
            } catch (e) {
              this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${keyOrPath}", ...)：JSON格式错误`);
              skip = true;
              break;
            }
          }

          // 统一格式修复（英文键→中文键+缺键互补）
          const { fixedEntryName, fixedValue } = this._fixFormat(keyOrPath, entryName, valueToAssign);
          entryName = fixedEntryName;
          valueToAssign = fixedValue;

          // 校验2：值是否为对象（排除null）
          if (typeof valueToAssign !== "object" || valueToAssign === null) {
            this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${keyOrPath}", ...)：值需为对象（如{"名称":"xxx"}）`);
            skip = true;
            break;
          }

          // 3个参数：新增条目（列表→对象添加键值对）
          if (args.length >= 3) {
            // 修复纯数字条目名称（避免数组）
            entryName = /^\d+$/.test(entryName) ? `条目_${entryName}` : entryName;
            // 确保列表是对象（非数组）
            if (Array.isArray(_.get(newState.stat_data, keyOrPath))) {
              _.set(newState.stat_data, keyOrPath, {});
            }
            const fullPath = `${keyOrPath}.${entryName}`;
            _.set(newState.stat_data, fullPath, valueToAssign);
            console.log(`[${command.command}指令后] 已新增条目: ${fullPath}`, valueToAssign);
          } 
          // 2个参数：更新已有对象属性（合并）
          else {
            const target = _.get(newState.stat_data, keyOrPath);
            if (_.isObject(target)) {
              _.merge(target, valueToAssign);
              console.log(`[${command.command}指令后] 已更新对象: ${keyOrPath}`, target);
            } else {
              this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}("${keyOrPath}", ...)：目标路径非对象，无法更新`);
              skip = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          modified = true;
          break;

        // 未识别指令：收集错误
        default:
          this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}(...)：未识别指令（仅支持set/add/remove/assign/insert）`);
          break;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 捕获意外异常（如JSON解析失败、路径格式错误等）
      this.errorCommands.push(`指令 ${command.command}(...)：执行失败（${e.message.slice(0, 30)}）`);
    }
    if (skip) continue;
  }

  console.log('[_applyUpdateFallback] 执行完毕：modified=', modified, '错误指令数:', this.errorCommands.length);
  // 批量弹出提示（错误数>0时）
  if (this.errorCommands.length > 0) {
    const errorText = `克莱恩提示：AI流口水了，${this.errorCommands.length}条指令失效！\n` +
      this.errorCommands.slice(0, 5).join("\n") +
      (this.errorCommands.length > 5 ? `\n...等${this.errorCommands.length - 5}条` : "") +
      "\n建议：在变量面板中修正错误后重新应用～";
    this.showTemporaryMessage(errorText, 8000);
    
  }

  return modified ? newState : null;
},

 _parseCommandValue(valStr) {
  if (typeof valStr !== "string") return valStr;
  const isFromUpdateVar = valStr.startsWith('__UPDATE_VAR__');
  const trimmed = isFromUpdateVar ? valStr.replace('__UPDATE_VAR__', '').trim() : valStr.trim();
  // 快速处理基础类型
  if (trimmed === "true") return true;
  if (trimmed === "false") return false;
  if (trimmed === "null") return undefined;

  // 格式修复1：补全中文键引号（如 {名称:"金镑"} → {"名称":"金镑"}）
  let fixedVal = trimmed;
  if (isFromUpdateVar && trimmed.startsWith("{") && trimmed.endsWith("}")) {
    // 无捕获组修复（仅处理中文键，不碰正文）
    fixedVal = trimmed.replace(
      /([\u4e00-\u9fa5]+)(\s*:)/g, 
      '\u0022\u00241\u0022\u00242' // 安全替换，只给中文键加引号
    );
  }

  // 尝试JSON解析（优先）
  try {
    if ((fixedVal.startsWith("{") && fixedVal.endsWith("}")) || (fixedVal.startsWith("[") && fixedVal.endsWith("]"))) {
      return JSON.parse(fixedVal);
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  // 备用：处理非标准对象字面量（无冗余日志）
  try {
    return new Function(`return ${fixedVal}`)();
  } catch (e) {}

  // 保底：纯字符串（去引号）
  return this._trimQuotes(valStr);

  _extractCommands(inputText) {
  const results = [];
  let i = 0;
  const textWithoutComments = inputText.replace(/\/\/.*$/gm, ''); // 移除//注释
  while (i < textWithoutComments.length) {
    // 跳过空行和空格
    while (i < textWithoutComments.length && /\s/.test(textWithoutComments[i])) {
      i++;
    }
    if (i >= textWithoutComments.length) break; // 处理完所有内容

    // 匹配_.set/assign等指令
    const match = textWithoutComments.substring(i).match(/_\.(set|assign|remove|add|insert)\(/);
    if (!match || match.index === undefined) break;

    const commandType = match[1];
    const start = i + match.index;
    const openParen = start + match[0].length;
    const closeParen = this._findMatchingCloseParen(textWithoutComments, openParen);
    
    if (closeParen === -1) {
      i = openParen;
      continue;
    }

    // 宽松匹配分号
    let endPos = closeParen + 1;
    while (endPos < textWithoutComments.length && textWithoutComments[endPos] !== ';') {
      if (!/\s/.test(textWithoutComments[endPos])) break; // 非空格非分号，停止跳过
      endPos++;
    }
    if (endPos < textWithoutComments.length && textWithoutComments[endPos] === ';') {
      endPos++; // 跳过分号
    }

    // 解析参数并添加到结果
    const paramsString = textWithoutComments.substring(openParen, closeParen);
    const params = this._parseParameters(paramsString);
    results.push({ command: commandType, args: params });
    i = endPos;
  }
  return results;
},

          _findMatchingCloseParen(text, start) {
  let count = 1;
  let inString = false;
  let stringDelimiter = '';

  for (let i = start; i < text.length; i++) {
    // 处理字符串开始/结束（避免越界）
    if (!inString && (text[i] === '\x22' || text[i] === '\x27')) {
      inString = true;
      stringDelimiter = text[i];
    } else if (inString && text[i] === stringDelimiter) {
      // 先判断i===0，避免text[i-1]越界
      if (i === 0 || text[i-1] !== '\\') {
        inString = false;
      }
    }

    // 仅非字符串时统计括号
    if (!inString) {
      if (text[i] === '(') count++;
      if (text[i] === ')') count--;
      if (count === 0) return i;
    }
  }
  return -1; // 未找到闭合括号
},

          _parseParameters(paramsString) {
              const params = [];
              let currentParam = '', inQuote = false, quoteChar = '', bracketCount = 0, braceCount = 0, parenCount = 0;
              for (let i = 0; i < paramsString.length; i++) {
                  const char = paramsString[i];
                  if ((char === '\x22' || char === '\x27' || char === '`') && (i === 0 || paramsString[i - 1] !== '\\')) {
                      if (!inQuote) { inQuote = true; quoteChar = char; }
                      else if (char === quoteChar) inQuote = false;
                  }
                  if (!inQuote) {
                      if (char === '(') parenCount++; if (char === ')') parenCount--;
                      if (char === '[') bracketCount++; if (char === ']') bracketCount--;
                      if (char === '{') braceCount++; if (char === '}') braceCount--;
                  }
                  if (char === ',' && !inQuote && parenCount === 0 && bracketCount === 0 && braceCount === 0) {
                      params.push(currentParam.trim());
                      currentParam = '';
                      continue;
                  }
                  currentParam += char;
              }
              if (currentParam.trim()) params.push(currentParam.trim());
              return params;
          },

          _getDisplayText(aiResponse) {
            try {
              if (!aiResponse || typeof aiResponse !== 'string') return '';

              // 优先策略：寻找 <gametxt> 标签
              const gameText = this._extractLastTagContent('gametxt', aiResponse);
              if (gameText !== null) {
                  return gameText
                      .replace(new RegExp('<!--[\\s\\S]*?-->', 'g'), '') // 第一步：移除 注释
                      .replace(/<safe>[\s\S]*?<\/safe>/g, '')       // 第二步：移除 <safe>...</safe> 及其内容
                      .trim();
              }

              // 备用策略：如果找不到 <gametxt>，则清理所有已知标签，并保留剩余的纯文本
              let cleanedText = aiResponse;
              const tagsToRemove = ['本周目经历', '历史的投影', 'UpdateVariable', '角色提取', 'thinking', 'gametxt']; // 也把gametxt加入清理列表，防止空标签残留
              
              tagsToRemove.forEach(tag => {
                  const regexWithContent = new RegExp(`<${tag}>[\s\S]*?<\/${tag}>`, 'gi');
                  cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(regexWithContent, '');
                  const regexSelfClosing = new RegExp(`<${tag}\s*\/>`, 'gi');
                  cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(regexSelfClosing, '');
              });

              // 最终清理：移除所有残余的、可能是HTML/XML的标签，例如 <p>, <div> 等
              cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '');

              // 如果清理后有实质内容，就返回它
              if (cleanedText.trim() !== '') {
                  return cleanedText.trim();
              }

              // 保底策略：如果以上方法都失败（例如，回复只包含标签而无任何其他文本），
              // 就返回空字符串，避免显示残留的标签或“摘要解析失败”。
              return '';

            } catch (e) {
              console.error("解析显示文本时出错:", e, "原始输入:", aiResponse);
              return "[摘要解析失败]";
            }
          },

                 _extractLastTagContent(tagName, text, ignoreCase = false) {
              if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return null;
              const endTag = `</${tagName}>`;
              let searchPool = text, endTagPattern = endTag;
              if (ignoreCase) { searchPool = text.toLowerCase(); endTagPattern = endTag.toLowerCase(); }
              const lastEndIndex = searchPool.lastIndexOf(endTagPattern);
              if (lastEndIndex !== -1) {
                  const startTag = `<${tagName}>`;
                  let startTagPattern = startTag;
                  if (ignoreCase) startTagPattern = startTag.toLowerCase();
                  const lastStartIndex = searchPool.lastIndexOf(startTagPattern, lastEndIndex);
                  if (lastStartIndex !== -1) {
                      return text.substring(lastStartIndex + startTag.length, lastEndIndex).trim();
                  }
              }
              return null;
          },

                    const nextTagMatch = fixedText.substring(startIndex).match(/<\/?\w+[^>]*>/);
                    let insertPosition = fixedText.length;

                    if (nextTagMatch && nextTagMatch.index !== undefined) {
                        insertPosition = startIndex + nextTagMatch.index;

                    fixedText = fixedText.slice(0, insertPosition).trim() + `</${tag}>\n` + fixedText.slice(insertPosition);

    }

    const tocList = document.getElementById('chronicle-toc-list');
    let html = '';

    // 1. 渲染“当前时间线”
    html += this.renderChronicleChapter(this.chatHistoryCache, 'current_timeline');

    // 2. 渲染已归档的分支
    const savesToRender = saves || await this.getSavesFromStorage();
    const manualSaveKeys = Object.keys(savesToRender).filter(key => key.startsWith('slot_')).sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a));
    manualSaveKeys.forEach(slotId => {
        html += this.renderChronicleChapter(savesToRender[slotId], slotId);

    tocList.innerHTML = html;
    this.bindChronicleListeners();
},
